four_consumers.contract: DOM description extraction skips non-string keys and Null/Sequence/Mapping/Tagged values; booleans/numbers stringify. Typed analytics denies unknown fields and duplicate maps via serde_with; parsing failure disables metrics.

DOM mapping accepts representable YAML keys, skips non-string keys, keeps scalar strings/bools/numbers, treats tags and containers as Other. Whole parse error is retained; malformed document cannot produce agent metadata.
Owned SkillFrontmatter; line-oriented repair uses a Value parse predicate. If repair also fails, original Error is preserved in public SkillParseError::InvalidYaml.
Typed optional interface/dependencies/policy, camelCase callbackPort plus callback_port alias; optional metadata parse failure preserves existing fail-open/default behavior, not new permission.

filter_execution_contract.require: Capture actual named tests and nonzero executed test count; zero matched tests is not PASS. Target names are derived from current BUILD.bazel/defs.bzl, not observed execution.
filter_execution_contract.bazel: Existing BUILD files use codex_rust_crate/all_crate_deps. MODULE.bazel:320 binds Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock; actual generated rename/alias resolution and Bazel lock refresh must be validated.

necessary_additional_behavior_checks: DOM mixed mapping with valid name/description plus integer and sequence keys: preserve valid fields while ignoring non-string keys. Do not silently change to whole-document rejection.
Explicit !tag scalar and mapping/sequence values: preserve current deliberate Other/None treatment; do not coerce tags to accepted scalar metadata.
Numbers/bools including negative/large u64/finite float/.nan/.inf and quoted leading-zero text: compare normalized strings and accepted/rejected shape.
Duplicate DOM keys and typed analytics operation/measurement/dimension keys: preserve rejection. Existing analytics negative test already exercises duplicate operations and measurements.

Malformed YAML and malformed UTF-8 from_slice: preserve error result; verify Error::location line/column/index API, original-error retention after failed repair, and current user-visible diagnostic expectations.
Existing frontmatter repair cases: colon/apostrophe text, invalid flow-like prose, block scalar body preservation, unknown fields, defaults and CRLF delimiters.
Typed optional metadata: callbackPort and callback_port, policy products, missing/invalid optional fields, deny_unknown_fields analytics, alias/merge-key behavior at actual caller boundaries.

noyalib_serde_yaml_0_0_56.finding: Mapping is IndexMap<String,Value>, borrowed key is &String, not &Value; key.as_str()? and key.as_str().map(str::trim) no longer type-check unchanged. Value has Tagged and Error has location, but that does not fix the mapping mismatch.
noyalib_serde_yaml_0_0_56.semantic_gap: The compat layer refuses non-scalar keys, while the existing DOM callers can ignore such keys and retain valid metadata. MappingAny exists outside the alias but requires an explicit DOM/visitor redesign, not a rename.
noyalib_serde_yaml_0_0_56.other_difference: Compat from_str/from_slice require DeserializeOwned+'static. Current inspected typed structs are owned, so this constraint alone is not the identified blocker.

serde_saphyr.finding: Typed Serde parser does not provide the intermediate Value DOM required by two consumers. An explicit visitor/DOM and duplicate/merge policy decisions are needed; not the smallest uniform migration.

other_forks.finding: Published manifests of yaml_serde 0.10.2 and serde_yaml_neo 0.11.0 still depend on original unsafe-libyaml ^0.2.11. serde_yaml_ng is explicitly described by RustSec as using unmaintained unsafe-libyaml.
